purpose: Issue-12 current post-correction classical uncertainty acceptance; historical Notebook-14 outputs and caches are not rewritten.

independent_reruns.policy: Two independent complete traversals per protocol; exact scientific records and fingerprints, excluding runtime.

day61.runtime_role: Context only, excluded from equality and acceptance
day61.detail_format_note: Pass-1 covariance endpoints were derivable from stored std/estimate; normalized details agree exactly with pass 2. Scientific record fingerprints were identical before reporting enrichment.

day62.runtime_role: Context only, excluded from equality and acceptance
day62.detail_format_note: All 1152 detailed JSON records agree exactly.

sequential_rng.day61: One seeded sequential RNG per physical condition: primary measurement, bootstrap draws, next primary measurement. No separate primary-generation pass.
sequential_rng.day62: One sequential bootstrap RNG seeded 62001 across A then B then C then D then E then F, in observation order. Invalid primary fits consume no bootstrap draws.

day61.identity_policy: Individual refit failures are included in exact scientific record fingerprints; no raw refit vectors stored.

day62.identity_policy: Individual refit failures are included in exact scientific record fingerprints; no raw refit vectors stored.

comparison_policy.exact: Schema, IDs, seeds, ordering, counts, covered/valid denominators, method/output kinds, nominal levels, failure IDs/reasons, and input/result/RNG fingerprints. No default numeric slack.
comparison_policy.metric_precision: Named standard deviations, widths and dimensionless scale ratios: half a four-decimal displayed unit. Point bias/MAE and empirical RMSE: half a six-decimal unit, consistent with earlier Issue-12 point metrics.
comparison_policy.rates: Coverage/failure fractions allow 1e-12 arithmetic roundoff only; their integer populations remain exact. Nominal 0.90 is not the regression target.
comparison_policy.wilson: 95% Wilson intervals are descriptive finite-sample interpretation, not regression tolerances. Day-61 coverage resolution is 1/50 when all intervals are valid.
comparison_policy.environment: Dependency versions are provenance, not rejection criteria; exact record fingerprints intentionally flag implementation/numerical drift for review even when summary differences are small.
comparison_policy.populations: Coverage = covered valid intervals / valid intervals. Attempted, evaluated, valid and failed populations are separate. Legacy finite-prediction failure is not strict fit failure.
comparison_policy.bootstrap: Production minimum is two successful refits. Partial failures and boundary hits remain reported, not reclassified. Repeated-Poisson variability remains an empirical reference.

protocol.rng_policy: one sequential RNG per condition: primary, bootstrap, next primary
one sequential bootstrap RNG across A-F; invalid primaries consume no bootstrap draws

historical_context.policy: Historical aggregate comparisons are informational. Current independent-run agreement and this explicit reference govern regression acceptance.

day61.interpretation: The two old tables already disagreed. Notebook differences are in conditions 3 and 6, consistent with corrected fitting and sequential-RNG effects. The older documentation does not pin equivalent RNG provenance; no claim that either historical table is wrong.

day62.interpretation: The historical cache predates numerical validation and half-bin fallback. Changed primary validity (including B/36 and Test C) changes later sequential bootstrap RNG progression. Aggregate comparison is informational, not per-observation equality with the old cache.
